title: ML Job Health & Remediation
description: Anomaly detection job health and performance, the alert conditions that drive automated remediation (delayed data, job errors, Logstash backlog), and what the automation did. Part of the Elastic ML Remediation Kit.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-elasticsearch.stack_monitoring.ml_job-* | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 10 minutes | STATS state = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.state, @timestamp), mem = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.model_size.memory_status, @timestamp) BY job = elasticsearch.ml.job.id | STATS `Jobs opened` = SUM(CASE(state == "opened", 1, 0)), `of jobs` = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-elasticsearch.stack_monitoring.ml_job-* | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 10 minutes | STATS state = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.state, @timestamp), mem = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.model_size.memory_status, @timestamp) BY job = elasticsearch.ml.job.id | STATS `Failed jobs` = SUM(CASE(state == "failed", 1, 0))

FROM metrics-elasticsearch.stack_monitoring.ml_job-* | WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 10 minutes | STATS state = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.state, @timestamp), mem = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.model_size.memory_status, @timestamp) BY job = elasticsearch.ml.job.id | STATS `At memory limit` = SUM(CASE(mem IN ("soft_limit", "hard_limit"), 1, 0))

FROM .alerts-stack.alerts-default | WHERE kibana.alert.status == "active" AND kibana.alert.rule.name IN ("ML Notifications - Delayed Data Detected", "ML Notifications - Job/Datafeed Errors", "Logstash persistent queue backing up") | STATS `Active alerts` = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.alert.uuid)

FROM .ml-notifications-* | WHERE timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend AND job_type == "anomaly_detector" AND message LIKE "*ingest latency*" | GROK message "Datafeed has missed %{DATA:missed_raw} documents due to ingest latency, latest bucket with missing data is \\[%{DATA:bucket}\\]" | EVAL missed_n = TO_LONG(REPLACE(missed_raw, ",", "")) | STATS missed = MAX(missed_n) BY job_id, bucket | STATS `Docs missed` = SUM(missed)
FROM ml-remediation-log | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND outcome == "applied" | STATS `Auto-fixes applied` = COUNT(*)
FROM ml-remediation-log | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND outcome IN ("escalated", "failed") | STATS `Escalations` = COUNT(*)

FROM metrics-elasticsearch.stack_monitoring.ml_job-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS state = LAST(elasticsearch.ml.job.state, @timestamp) BY job = elasticsearch.ml.job.id, t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | STATS jobs = COUNT(*) BY t, state

config.title: Job warnings and errors by type

data_source.query: FROM .ml-notifications-* | WHERE timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend AND job_type == "anomaly_detector" AND level IN ("warning", "error") | EVAL type = CASE(message LIKE "*ingest latency*", "Delayed data", message LIKE "*no data*", "No data", message LIKE "*extracting data*", "Extraction error", message LIKE "*No node found*", "No node to start", message LIKE "*memory*", "Memory", message LIKE "*flushing*", "Flush error", "Other") | STATS messages = COUNT(*) BY t = BUCKET(timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), type

FROM .ml-notifications-* | WHERE timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend AND message LIKE "*ingest latency*" | GROK message "Datafeed has missed %{DATA:missed_raw} documents due to ingest latency, latest bucket with missing data is \\[%{DATA:bucket}\\]" | EVAL missed_n = TO_LONG(REPLACE(missed_raw, ",", "")) | STATS missed = MAX(missed_n) BY job_id, bucket | STATS missed = SUM(missed) BY job_id | SORT missed DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM .ml-anomalies-* | WHERE result_type == "bucket" AND timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(processing_time_ms, 50), p95 = PERCENTILE(processing_time_ms, 95) BY t = BUCKET(timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

FROM metrics-elasticsearch.stack_monitoring.ml_job-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS hi = MAX(elasticsearch.ml.job.data_counts.processed_record_count), lo = MIN(elasticsearch.ml.job.data_counts.processed_record_count) BY job = elasticsearch.ml.job.id, t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL delta = CASE(hi >= lo, hi - lo, 0) | STATS records = SUM(delta) BY t

FROM .alerts-stack.alerts-default | WHERE kibana.alert.rule.name IN ("ML Notifications - Delayed Data Detected", "ML Notifications - Job/Datafeed Errors", "Logstash persistent queue backing up") AND kibana.alert.start >= ?_tstart AND kibana.alert.start <= ?_tend | STATS alerts = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.alert.uuid) BY t = BUCKET(kibana.alert.start, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), rule = kibana.alert.rule.name
FROM ml-remediation-log | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND outcome != "no_action" | STATS actions = COUNT(*) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), outcome

FROM metrics-logstash.pipeline-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend AND logstash.pipeline.total.queues.type == "persisted" | STATS queue = MAX(logstash.pipeline.total.queues.current_size.bytes) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 48, ?_tstart, ?_tend), pipeline = logstash.pipeline.name

FROM .ml-anomalies-* | WHERE result_type == "model_size_stats" AND timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS model_bytes = LAST(model_bytes, timestamp), limit_raw = LAST(model_bytes_memory_limit, timestamp), memory_status = LAST(memory_status, timestamp), by_fields = LAST(total_by_field_count, timestamp) BY job_id | EVAL limit_bytes = TO_DOUBLE(limit_raw), `Model MB` = ROUND(model_bytes / 1048576.0, 1), `Limit MB` = ROUND(limit_bytes / 1048576.0), `% of limit` = ROUND(100.0 * model_bytes / limit_bytes, 1) | SORT `% of limit` DESC | KEEP job_id, memory_status, `Model MB`, `Limit MB`, `% of limit`, by_fields | LIMIT 50

FROM .ml-notifications-* | WHERE timestamp >= ?_tstart AND timestamp <= ?_tend AND job_type == "anomaly_detector" AND level IN ("warning", "error") | EVAL type = CASE(message LIKE "*ingest latency*", "Delayed data", message LIKE "*no data*", "No data", message LIKE "*extracting data*", "Extraction error", message LIKE "*No node found*", "No node to start", message LIKE "*memory*", "Memory", message LIKE "*flushing*", "Flush error", "Other") | STATS Warnings = SUM(CASE(level == "warning", 1, 0)), Errors = SUM(CASE(level == "error", 1, 0)), `Latest problem` = LAST(type, timestamp), `Last seen` = MAX(timestamp) BY job_id | SORT Errors DESC, Warnings DESC | LIMIT 50

FROM ml-remediation-log | WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tend - 7 days AND outcome != "no_action" | STATS Actions = COUNT(*), `Last action` = MAX(@timestamp), `query_delay now` = LAST(query_delay_after, @timestamp), Case = LAST(case_id, @timestamp) BY job_id, action, outcome | SORT `Last action` DESC | LIMIT 100
